name: pdfstruct
description: Convert documents and images locally with PDFStruct. Claude gets statuses and file names, not the document content.
long_description: Connector for a locally installed PDFStruct. It starts the `pdfstruct-mcp` command of your PDFStruct installation; the bundle itself contains no conversion engine and no OCR models. Install PDFStruct first (setup-windows.cmd from the repository, or pip install "pdfstruct[mcp]"), then point this extension at the pdfstruct-mcp command if it is not on PATH.

tools.name: convert
tools.description: Convert local files; returns status and output file names only.

tools.name: inspect
tools.description: Type, size, page count and likely method of a file. No content.

tools.name: supported_formats
tools.description: Input and output formats and their limits.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Find a phrase in a converted document (short snippets).

tools.name: read_excerpt
tools.description: Read at most 2000 characters of extracted text.

pdfstruct_mcp.title: pdfstruct-mcp command
pdfstruct_mcp.description: Full path to pdfstruct-mcp (Windows: the pdfstruct-mcp.exe inside the .venv/Scripts folder of your PDFStruct installation). Leave the default if it is on PATH.
